title: 8 Signs a Godly Man Answers to God, Not His Urges
caption:
8 signs a godly man answers to God, not his urges. Neither does the culture that raised him.

He waits before he responds, not just before he reacts. He keeps a promise to himself nobody else would notice broken. He treats his body like it belongs to Someone else. He asks God to search him before he defends himself.

Governed, not controlled. That's the difference.

#faith #christianman #selfcontrol #godlymen #manofgod #discipleship #holiness
theme: He runs his life — his impulses don't control him.
